purpose: Map all possible causal paths from user intent before any execution

WORKFLOW.step_2_enumerate_paths: What are ALL possible ways to achieve this?
WORKFLOW.step_4_build_tree: Create branching map showing all paths
WORKFLOW.step_7_document_tree: Record chosen path + why not others
WORKFLOW.step_8_execute: Code ONLY according to chosen path
WORKFLOW.rule: Tree created and verified BEFORE any file creation

TREE_DECISION_GATES.gate_1_type_A: Does framework already pattern this? YES → Use Type A path
TREE_DECISION_GATES.gate_2_type_B: Is there state/precondition? YES → Use Type B path, verify preconditions
TREE_DECISION_GATES.gate_3_type_C: Are we forced by constraints? YES → Use Type C path, document why
TREE_DECISION_GATES.gate_4_type_D: Does outcome contradict framework? YES → STOP, expand framework first
TREE_DECISION_GATES.gate_5_go_no_go: Is chosen path framework-aligned + verified? YES → Execute, NO → Reconsider

TREE_DOCUMENTATION_TEMPLATE.chosen_because: Why this path chosen over others
TREE_DOCUMENTATION_TEMPLATE.verification_plan: How will we know this path works?

sequence: 2. Verify chosen path against PRE_ACTION_GATE (5 questions)
5. If UFM quality_score > 0.75: Log tree + execute
6. If UFM quality_score < 0.75: Reconsider tree, find different path
INTEGRATION_WITH_UFM_GATE.rule: Tree verification happens WITHIN UFM validation flow

EXAMPLE_TREE_FOR_PROJECT_READER_REQUEST.request: create a way to get and read entire project at once
EXAMPLE_TREE_FOR_PROJECT_READER_REQUEST.parsed_intent: User needs comprehensive project access for analysis/understanding

possible_paths.approach: Create song type for project reading in UNIVERSAL_RENDERER
possible_paths.causal_flow: User request → UNIVERSAL_RENDERER generates 'ProjectReader song' → ElectionSequencer tracks → ARIA translates to Markdown/JSON output

EXAMPLE_TREE_FOR_PROJECT_READER_REQUEST.WHAT_WENT_WRONG: I chose C1 (standalone PROJECT_READER.py) instead of A1 (framework-integrated song). Violated framework, created parallel infrastructure, pattern repeated immediately after claiming to understand it.

PRE_EXECUTION_CHECKLIST.check_2_path_classified: Is chosen path Type A/B/C/D classified?
PRE_EXECUTION_CHECKLIST.check_4_preconditions: If Type B - are preconditions met?
PRE_EXECUTION_CHECKLIST.check_6_tree_logged: Is tree saved to decision log?

CORE_RULE: NO CODE WITHOUT CAUSAL TREE. NO TREE WITHOUT CLASSIFICATION. NO EXECUTION WITHOUT UFM VERIFICATION.
INTEGRATION: Causal Tree → PRE_ACTION_GATE → UFM API validation → Execution
